ops_applied.rationale: Adds the article number 747 that the full text read in the run prints (npj Digital Medicine | (2025)8:747); the article type of vancouver.bst prints pages after a colon, so the reference reads 2025 Dec;8(1):747.
Adds the article number 1 that the full text read in the run prints (Scientific Data | (2023) 10:1), so the reference reads 2023 Jan;10(1):1.

The webpage type of vancouver.bst prints the url field and never the doi field, so the url becomes the doi.org link of the entry's DOI 10.13026/4NQG-SB35, which the DOI registry's record ties to the same version 1.0 page; the reference then prints its persistent identifier like the other references.
Adds the article number 1760 that the full text read in the run prints (NATURE COMMUNICATIONS | (2020)11:1760), so the reference reads 2020 Apr;11(1):1760.
Adds the article number 24 that the full text read in the run prints (BMC Medical Research Methodology (2018) 18:24), so the reference reads 2018 Feb;18(1):24.

The entry type changes from inbook, whose vancouver.bst function asks for a chapter and prints the title as the book's title, to inproceedings, which prints the title as the paper's title and the booktitle after In:, so the reference names the ECCV 2014 proceedings; every field is kept.
